mcqs.question: India’s first National Report (NR1) on Access and Benefit-Sharing under the Nagoya Protocol was submitted to the Convention on Biological Diversity by which organisations?
options: MoEFCC and the National Biodiversity Authority
The Convention on Biological Diversity and the National Biodiversity Authority
The National Biodiversity Authority and State Biodiversity Boards
MoEFCC and the Convention on Biological Diversity
mcqs.explanation: India’s first National Report (NR1) on Access and Benefit-Sharing was submitted to the Convention on Biological Diversity by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change and the National Biodiversity Authority. The Convention on Biological Diversity was the recipient, not one of the submitting organisations.
